title: Molecular simulation reveals that pathogenic mutations in BTB/ANK domains of Arabidopsis thaliana NPR1 circumscribe the EDS1-mediated immune regulation.
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究拟南芥NPR1蛋白BTB/ANK结构域致病突变对NPR1-EDS1互作的影响，属于蛋白质-蛋白质互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD与自由能计算方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模，故给予中档评分。
abstract: The NPR1 (nonexpressor of pathogenesis-related genes 1) is a key regulator of the salicylic-acid-mediated immune response caused by pathogens in Arabidopsis thaliana. Mutations C150Y and H334Y in the BTB/ANK domains of NPR1 inhibit the defense response, and transcriptional co-activity with enhanced disease susceptibility 1 (EDS1) has been revealed experimentally. This study examined the conformational changes and reduced NPR1-EDS1 interaction upon mutation using a molecular dynamics simulation. Initially, (BTB)C150Y(NPR1) and (ANK)H334Y(NPR1) were categorized as pathological mutations rather than others based on sequence conservation. A distant ortholog was used to map the common residues shared among the wild-type because the mutations were highly conserved. Overall, 179 of 373 residues were determining the secondary structures and fold versatility of conformations. In addition, the mutational hotspots Cys150, Asp152, Glu153, Cys155, His157, Cys160, His334, Arg339 and Lys370 were crucial for oligomer-to-monomer exchange. Subsequently, the atomistic simulations with free energy (MM/PB(GB)SA) calculations predicted structural displacements engaging in the N-termini (alpha5)133-178(alpha7) linker connecting the central ANK regions ((alpha13)260-290(alpha14) and (alpha18)320-390(alpha22)), where prominent long helices (alpha5(16)) and short helices (alpha3(10)) replaced with beta-turns and loops disrupting hydrogen bonds and salt bridges in both mutants implicating functional regulation and activation. Furthermore, the mutation repositions the intact stability of multiple regions ((L13)C149-N356(alpha20)(BTB/ANK)-(alpha17)W301-E357(alpha21)(N-ter/coiled-coil)) compromising a dynamic interaction of NPR1-EDS1. By unveiling the transitions between the distinct functions of mutational perception, this study paves the way for future investigation to orchestrate additive host-adapted transcriptional reprogramming that controls defense-related regulatory mechanisms of NPR1s in plants.
abstract_zh: NPR1（非致病相关基因表达子1）是拟南芥中由病原体引发的、由水杨酸介导的免疫反应的关键调控因子。NPR1的BTB/ANK结构域中的C150Y和H334Y突变抑制了防御反应，并且实验已揭示其与增强疾病易感性1（EDS1）的转录共活性。本研究利用分子动力学模拟，探讨了突变引起的构象变化及NPR1-EDS1相互作用的减弱。首先，基于序列保守性，(BTB)C150Y(NPR1)和(ANK)H334Y(NPR1)被归类为病理性突变，而非其他类型。由于这些突变高度保守，使用远缘直系同源物来映射野生型中共享的常见残基。总体而言，373个残基中的179个决定了构象的二级结构和折叠多样性。此外，突变热点Cys150、Asp152、Glu153、Cys155、His157、Cys160、His334、Arg339和Lys370对寡聚体向单体的转换至关重要。随后，结合自由能（MM/PB(GB)SA）计算的原子级模拟预测了结构位移，涉及连接中央ANK区域（(alpha13)260-290(alpha14)和(alpha18)320-390(alpha22)）的N端（alpha5）133-178(alpha7)连接子，其中显著的长螺旋（alpha5(16)）和短螺旋（alpha3(10)）被β-转角和无规卷曲取代，破坏了两种突变体中的氢键和盐桥，从而影响功能调控和激活。此外，突变重新定位了多个区域（(L13)C149-N356(alpha20)(BTB/ANK)-(alpha17)W301-E357(alpha21)(N端/卷曲螺旋)）的完整稳定性，损害了NPR1-EDS1的动态相互作用。通过揭示突变感知不同功能之间的转变，本研究为未来研究铺平了道路，以协调附加的宿主适应性转录重编程，从而控制植物中NPR1s的防御相关调控机制。
